summary: MSP Recovery, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its securities will be moved from the OTC Pink Limited Information tier to the OTC Expert Market effective July 17, 2026 due to failure to file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for 2025 and Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for Q1 2026. Trading will be restricted to unsolicited quotes from non-affiliate retail and institutional investors. The company does not expect to regain compliance before the grace period ends. This represents a de facto delisting from active OTC quoting, with limited liquidity and no ongoing price discovery. Watch for potential further regulatory actions or a possible reverse split or going-private transaction to resolve the reporting delinquency.
